name: Intermediate Strength: Upper / Lower
description: Four days a week, two upper-body and two lower-body workouts, for lifters who can no longer add weight every session. Twelve weeks in blocks: a volume block of more sets and reps, a strength block of heavier fives, a deload week, then a peak block of heavy doubles and triples. Within each block, add weight when you reach the top of the rep range on every set. Exercises marked optional add arms, shoulders, calves or abs for a longer day; leave them out when short of time.
